brief:
Several Palestinians were wounded Sunday when a strike struck a displacement shelter tent near Al-Aqsa University west of Khan Younis city in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said the strike targeted a tent housing displaced persons within one of the encampments established in the area near the university.

The incident occurred as Palestinians remain sheltered in makeshift camps throughout southern Gaza. Exact casualty figures were not immediately confirmed. Local sources provided no statement on what prompted the strike or which parties were involved in the incident.
